tools.name: batch_documents
tools.description: Use for multiple explicitly selected documents that need the same action; for one document prefer the matching single-document tool. Accepts 1–25 IDs for automation compatibility. Supports move, set_category, add_tag, remove_tag, trash, restore, or refresh_index. Processes sequentially through the existing API with a permission check per document and a per-ID result; partial success is possible. Stops after authentication or rate-limit failure. Never expands a search result or permanently purges documents; version restore is separate.

localizations.description: Cloud or self-hosted knowledge for AI agents: hybrid search, reranking, GraphRAG, scoped MCP tools.
localizations.summary:
Search, read, create, and organize the same documents you use in DocsMint. Choose DocsMint Cloud for the simplest connection, or connect a self-hosted workspace with the stdio bridge.

## DocsMint Cloud — recommended

1. Open [DocsMint Cloud setup](https://docsmint.com/mcp/connect?source=lobehub_mcp).
2. Connect to `https://docsmint.com/mcp` over Streamable HTTP; no server deployment or local process is required.
3. OAuth clients discover hosted authorization. Follow the [DocsMint Cloud setup guide](https://docsmint.com/mcp/connect?source=lobehub_mcp) for currently supported discovery and client-connection methods. Consent binds one-hour access tokens to a workspace, optional category, and scopes. Refresh tokens are not issued.
4. Clients using API keys can send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` with a workspace-bound or category-scoped credential created in the authenticated browser UI.

## Self-hosted — advanced

1. [Install DocsMint with Docker](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint#quickstart).
2. Create an API key in your DocsMint browser UI.
3. Set `HIAI_DOCS_URL` and `HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY` in your MCP client's environment, then run the stdio bridge:

```sh
bunx --package @hiai-gg/docsmint@1.0.2 docsmint-mcp
```

The npm package connects to your existing DocsMint API with your API key; it does not install the application, database, or hosted Cloud OAuth server.

[Client configuration](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/packages/mcp-server/README.md) · [Docker images](https://hub.docker.com/r/vgalibov/docsmint) · [Deployment guide](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)

## What your agent can do

- Search documents with hybrid retrieval and GraphRAG.
- Read, create, update, and organize documents within the granted scope.
- Manage tags, folders, categories, version history, indexing, and document trash.
- Apply bounded batch actions and inspect one visible folder, category, or tag by UUID.

## Latest release: 1.0.2

Clarifies when agents should choose a single-document tool or bounded batch_documents. The 22-tool catalog, all 31 underlying operations, schemas, permissions, and stdio behavior remain unchanged. Batch actions remain sequential and can report partial success. The hosted DocsMint Cloud Connector remains separate; this OSS release does not change its deployed tool descriptions. No database migration or hosted OAuth change is required.

[Release notes](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/releases/tag/v1.0.2) · [Current README](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint#readme) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
